description: This Java source file defines the class 'JacksonSerializationContext', which implements the 'SerializationContext' interface. It provides methods for serializing data to CBOR format using Jackson's JsonGenerator, encapsulating output stream management, writing various data types, and handling internal buffering and control over output streaming.

classes.name: JacksonSerializationContext
classes.description: Implementation of SerializationContext that uses Jackson's JsonGenerator to serialize data into CBOR format, managing output streams and providing serialization methods for various data types.

classes.name: ControllableOutputStream
classes.description: Nested static class for an output stream that can be toggled on or off to control whether data is written, used internally by JacksonSerializationContext to manage output flow.

methods.name: JacksonSerializationContext
methods.description: Constructs a new serialization context with a given Jackson factory and output stream, setting up the generator.

methods.name: getJacksonGenerator
methods.description: Returns the internal Jackson JsonGenerator instance used for serialization.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the internal JsonGenerator, releasing resources.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the generator and underlying output stream.

methods.name: writeCachedElement
methods.description: Writes pre-cached byte array data into the output, flushing first and informing Jackson that one element has been written.

methods.name: writeNumber
methods.description: Overloaded methods to serialize float, double, long, and int numbers.

methods.name: writeFieldName
methods.description: Sets the current field name for the following value in the JSON structure.

methods.name: informJacksonThatOneElementWasWritten
methods.description: Signals to Jackson that an element has been written by temporarily disabling the output stream, writing a null, and flushing.
